name: Mag. Stefan
site: wienenergie.at · Electricity, gas and district heating, Austria
headline: Turn Wien Energie’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells electricity, gas and district heating tariffs, plus internet and business offers, to every visitor the same way, whether they are a household in Vienna or a business customer.
Once a customer is logged in, their consumption, meter readings and instalment changes are the strongest signal you own. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns for tariffs, internet and heating are built by hand, per segment, per month. A household that is about to cancel this week gets the same tariff mail as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Per household, the AI reads consumption changes, instalment payments and account activity to spot a likely cancellation early. Each one then gets the right offer, channel and moment.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Match each customer to the right tariff
cases.text: Next best tariff, internet or heating add-on per customer, triggered by actual consumption and recent account activity. No more blanket upgrade mails to households already on a tariff that fits.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep customers engaged with their account
cases.text: Personal nudges by email and in the customer account, such as saving tips tied to each household’s own consumption, so every customer has a reason to log in again.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
